title: Benchmarking Python Web Frameworks under Generative AI Workloads: benchmark code and data
description:
Benchmark harness and data for the paper "Benchmarking Python Web Frameworks under Generative AI Workloads: A Comparison of Synchronous and Asynchronous Architectures". Flask and Django (Gunicorn sync, 1 and 17 workers), FastAPI (Uvicorn) and Tornado serve blocking, SSE streaming and RAG-style pipeline endpoints in front of a calibrated simulator of the Anthropic Messages API, at 1 to 100 concurrent users with 5 runs per configuration, plus a validation against the live API. Code is MIT licensed; the data in data_v2/, data_v2_real/, results_v2/, analysis/out/, data/ and results/ are licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).

Release v2.1 adds the exact table-source snapshot from the JISA manuscript prepared on 26 October 2026 from the checked 23 October baseline, SHA-256 provenance and a portable standard-library-only numerical comparison. The checker compares 854 printed numerical values across the throughput, latency, resource, live-API and historical-comparison table files, plus one caption footnote with the archived aggregate numbers. Raw measurements and numerical analysis logic are unchanged. This record contains software and supporting research data; the associated manuscript is unpublished and is not included as a preprint in this record. Table sources in paper_snapshot/tables/ are CC BY 4.0; code and documentation are MIT licensed.
